description: Sets/corrects the shipping address for an order resolved from the visible order Reference. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

body.description: WAPI shipping address payload. Include shippingAddress only; the MCP resolves the order line from the visible order Reference.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_set_shipping_address
title: Set Shipping Address
